description: Airports in the Lounge Frog directory with their city, country, number of open lounges, editorial rating, and page link. Search by code, name or city, or narrow to one country or to airports with lounges. get_airport has one airport's terminals and lounges.

country.description: Country name as the directory writes it, e.g. "United States"

has_lounges.description: Only airports with at least one open lounge

query.description: Code, name or city, e.g. "London" or "DFW"

name: list_airports
title: Find airports
